Subject: A gift with a reason
Graphic brief: Birthday reminder transforms into a bouquet reveal. Use a short petal trail; keep the photo and note uncovered.

Subject: Start with a preset
Graphic brief: Short leader and tap pulse on the selected Sweetheart preset, then clear the graphic.

Subject: Flowers and quantity
Graphic brief: Track the actual selected flower and plus button. Roll the quantity only on observed taps; no decorative catalog covering the real catalog.

Subject: Greenery and depth
Graphic brief: A drawn depth bracket connects lower front and higher back after the layout changes.

Subject: Wrap, ribbon, color
Graphic brief: Three distinct paper, ribbon and color accents, placed outside active tap targets.

Subject: Adjust all flowers
Graphic brief: One measurement graphic at a time: height arrow, size ring, spread bracket. Keep the slider and bouquet visible together.

Subject: Adjust one flower
Graphic brief: Call out the real selected rose, then map height, size, horizontal position and depth to separate directional graphics.

Subject: Explore arrangements
Graphic brief: A reversible curved arrow lands with Undo and reverses with Redo; no repeating instructions already visible on the button.

Subject: Place a companion
Graphic brief: An outlined placement ring and rotation arc follows the teddy. Clear them once the object settles.

Subject: Write and seal a letter
Graphic brief: An ink flourish at the letter entrance, a brief handwriting cue at editing, and a wax-seal accent after Save & seal. Never cover the native reveal.

Subject: Frame a memory
Graphic brief: A corner crop guide and portrait-to-landscape diagram, each synchronized to the real action and clear of the photo.

Subject: A small celebration
Graphic brief: Keep this to three seconds. Let the native burst carry the scene, with a single short editorial spark accent.

Subject: Personalize and share
Graphic brief: A small name-to-gift connection, then a checkmark after the copied state. Show the actual exported card as a separate item.

Subject: The gift opens
Graphic brief: Tap ripple, then withdraw. Leave the recipient view and complete native letter animation unobstructed.

Subject: When to use it
Graphic brief: Three occasion labels follow the matching bouquets, then a clear end card with a restrained animated flower mark.
